gate.description: The frozen public standard and review operating system require genuine external critique before further capability expansion or stronger public-legitimacy claims.

next_action.description: Obtain genuine independent critique from the identified reviewer lanes, log each real response separately from the example entries, and use the review-response process to record accepted, partially accepted, rejected, or deferred outcomes before considering further capability expansion.

blockers: All current reviewer lanes remain at Identified rather than Asked, Received, or Logged.
The existing response log contains example reviewers, not genuine independent review evidence.
Donation and sponsorship readiness work does not itself authorize activation or satisfy the external-review gate.
